subject.title: feat(workshop): allow restoring rejected proposals back to pending

question: Should OpenClaw support restoring rejected Skill Workshop proposals back to pending through the service, gateway RPC, CLI, and Control UI surfaces in this PR?
rationale: This is a new lifecycle and public/operator API capability, so implementation quality alone cannot decide product acceptance.

options.title: Accept restore after repair
options.body: Proceed with restore once CLI config enforcement and docs are fixed and focused checks pass.

options.title: Narrow the restore surface
options.body: Ask for a smaller service/API or CLI-only shape if maintainers want less UI or protocol surface initially.

options.title: Reject restore semantics
options.body: Keep rejected proposals as immutable review history and close this PR plus the linked feature issue with that rationale.

recommendation.title: Accept restore after repair
recommendation.body: Proceed with restore once CLI config enforcement and docs are fixed and focused checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: The Skill Workshop lifecycle and public surfaces appear to originate from this owner history, making it the best available product/API routing signal.
